content.short: Kaito is an AI-powered search engine for the crypto industry that indexes fragmented social and technical data.
content.description: Kaito is an advanced, AI-driven search engine tailored for the blockchain industry. It solves information fragmentation by indexing data from Twitter, Farcaster, research papers, and forums. By providing institutional-grade tools like Kaito Pro, the platform enables investors and researchers to track sentiment shifts and market narratives with precision. Additionally, Kaito features the Yaps system, which quantifies and rewards meaningful engagement. As a foundational layer for crypto intelligence, Kaito provides both retail and institutional participants with actionable market insights.
content.meta: Kaito provides AI-powered crypto search and sentiment analysis for Web3 data. Discover Kaito and other Infrastructure Tools on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
